verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents its own APIs: one to update candidates, add attachments, and advance, move or reject applications, plus a Job Board API, Candidate Ingestion and Assessment partner APIs, and webhooks. That covers core recruiting operations, but nothing claims or shows that the API matches what the UI can do. Many UI features (reporting and filters, AI Notetaker, Voice AI, Talent Matching, bulk outreach, onboarding) have no documented API equivalent, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented API-UI parity claim, API coverage of reporting, AI and sourcing features, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent verification of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
